articles.title: Bank group sues U.S. regulator over granting crypto trust charters
articles.snippet: The Independent Community Bankers of America sued the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, accusing the regulator of overstepping its legal authority.

articles.title: Another Trump memecoin dinner advertised for token's top investors
articles.snippet: The company managing the memecoin calls the November event the "most exclusive dinner in the world."

articles.title: European crypto users have ‘more faith’ in regulated firms under MiCA: Bitpanda co-CEO
articles.snippet: Speaking on Cointelegraph’s Chain Reaction, Christian Trummer said MiCA has increased trust in regulated platforms and called for stricter enforcement against noncompliant firms.

articles.title: Crypto’s billions are back, but the premiums aren’t
articles.snippet: Kalshi seeks a $40 billion valuation, while Blockchain.com targets an IPO and crypto treasury companies struggle to maintain their once-high valuations.

articles.title: CONNECT recap: Arthur Hayes on money printing, Wall Street moves onchain
articles.snippet: Arthur Hayes said money printing could lift crypto prices, while CONNECT Seoul speakers examined Wall Street’s competitive edge onchain.
